name: channel_ingest_distill_user
content: Distill this {channel} thread update per the system contract. Respond with ONLY the JSON object.

variables.name: channel
variables.description: Channel word for the message, kept generic so the prompt stays channel-agnostic ('email' | 'chat' | 'message').

variables.name: header_document
variables.description: Metadata header block built by channel_assist::assist::content::build_header_document (subject, sender, recipient domains, date, direction, attachment count) - already-persisted metadata only.
examples:
Subject: Quarterly planning
From: Alice Example <alice@example.com>
Date: 2026-07-01T09:00:00+00:00
Direction: inbound

variables.name: content
variables.description: The message's new content, or a same-thread newest-first batch assembled from recent messages. Quoted history/signatures are already stripped where the provider supports it. Exists in process memory only and is never persisted.
examples: Can we move Thursday's sync to Friday morning?

variables.name: content_truncated
variables.description: Whether the supplied content contains only the beginning of the available message or thread batch.

metadata.description: User prompt for the legacy channel-assist local distillation contract with explicit truncation state.
metadata.author: magician
metadata.changelog: v1.0.1: Replaces a Rust-authored truncation sentence with an explicit managed boolean prompt field.
